description: Change properties of a HubSpot contact, company, deal or task (internal names; deal stage = stage id from list_hubspot_pipelines). Reads the record first (returns previous values) and afterwards checks that HubSpot stored every value. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run when write_mode is "dry_run" or dry_run is set.

dry_run.description: Only simulate and report what would happen; change nothing

id.description: ID of the HubSpot record to change

object.description: HubSpot object type of the record

properties.description: Property values to set (property name → value)

name: update_hubspot_record
